# Task-Laureate

> Task-Laureate is a free, open-source, privacy-minded task workspace for individuals who want to plan lists, prioritize work, track progress, and keep their data under their control.

## What it does

- Creates lists and tasks with priorities, due dates, tags, and notes.
- Shows progress, completed work, task status, search, and activity history.
- Supports account-scoped Supabase sync with row-level security, optional social sign-in, export/import, and device-local browser alerts.
- Works as a responsive web application and can be self-hosted on Vercel.

## What it does not claim

- It is not a multi-user collaboration suite or a replacement for an organization-wide project-management system.
- Browser alerts are optional, device-specific, and best-effort; the in-app inbox is the durable notification record.
- It does not promise offline operation, real-time delivery, or universal AI/search ranking.

## Public pages

- Product overview: https://tasks.ai-aarti.com/about/
- Support: https://tasks.ai-aarti.com/support
- Application: https://tasks.ai-aarti.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/aartisr/task-laureate

## Primary audience

Students, makers, and focused individuals who want a clean personal task workspace with transparent data handling.
